items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: He was Charles August, and Lil Joe, myself, and his boy Clifford Brown. He was five pieces.

ctx.x: There's been a Morris, a bass player. That's his son, that's his son.

And he could sing any blues. They had the people there, but they had a, we call it armor there, you know, and a shikiro, packed up from the bottom to the top. Nothing but records. Nothing but blues. And any blues, they could say, give me a chord in B flat or a chord in C or a chord in G. And he would sing them blues out to Dave Foster. We had five pieces out there. He was Charles August, and Lil Joe, myself, and his boy Clifford Brown. He was five pieces. Now a long time before that, I played green clarinet in…
Well, I'd get him to play in my place.
